title: Data and analysis code for: iPLA: Immunosorbent Proximity Ligation Assay with qPCR-Conformant Calibration, Demonstrated on Neurofilament Light Chain in Brain Disorders
description:
Raw data, Jupyter notebooks and figure/table files supporting the manuscript "iPLA: Immunosorbent Proximity Ligation Assay with qPCR-Conformant Calibration, Demonstrated on Neurofilament Light Chain in Brain Disorders". Each folder corresponds to an analysis in the manuscript. The conda environment is specified in environment.yml.

Licensing: data are released under CC-BY-4.0; analysis code (notebooks and ProxiPal.py) is released under the MIT licence (see LICENSE).
